headline: Aman Group luxury resort network and Capital Group development company are studying Bukhara
summary: Uzbek official Saida Mirziyoyeva met Aman Group chairman Vladislav Doronin and Capital Group board chairman Pavel Tyo. The parties discussed developing tourism in Bukhara.
why: Aman Group operates a network of luxury resorts and hotels, and developers like Capital Group build hospitality and real estate projects. Such investment talks can signal new tourism capital flows into a region.
original_headline: Aman Group lyuks kurortlar tarmog‘i va Capital Group developerlik kompaniyasi Buxoroni o‘rganmoqda
